entries.title: WhatsApp attachment recovery
notes: Manual WhatsApp attachment downloads now use the 250 MB recovery limit instead of the smaller 25 MB background limit. Both limits respect your installation settings.
Stale attachment links request a fresh copy from the connected phone once, and refreshed download details survive a restart.
Repeated recovery clicks share one download. Interrupted downloads do not leave partial files behind.
Size limits, connection interruptions and storage problems no longer appear as expired attachments. Files unavailable on WhatsApp still require the original file or a resend.

entries.title: Native X message controls
notes: Edit your verified sent text messages through the X browser connection, directly from the existing message menu.
Delete your own messages for everyone when X Chat offers Delete for all. It never falls back to deleting only your copy.
Actions verify the exact conversation, native message ID and sender, then reload X to check the result before showing success.
X permission and edit limits still apply. Unverified previews must load their full messages first, and uncertain actions are never automatically retried.
Sending and message changes share one queue so they cannot interfere with each other. Existing drafts and translation links remain protected.

entries.title: Message controls and protected links
notes: Edit your sent text messages and delete your own messages for everyone on Telegram, WhatsApp, and official Discord bot connections, subject to platform permissions and time limits.
Message actions live in the existing menu. Edit inline without losing your reply draft; deletion asks for confirmation first.
Personal Discord search connections remain read-only. X and email do not offer native editing or deletion in this release.
URLs and email addresses are protected during translation. Link-only messages bypass translation, and unsafe translation results are blocked before sending.
Confirmed changes survive history refreshes. Uncertain platform actions are flagged and never automatically retried.

entries.title: Updates on your terms
notes: Choose automatic updates during onboarding or in Settings → General. They start off unless you opt in.
Every update notice offers Update now, Skip this version, and an automatic updates switch.
Automatic installation waits for a visible 60-second countdown with no activity or saved drafts while the inbox is open.
Skipped versions and failed automatic attempts are not automatically retried. Review a skipped update from Settings whenever you want.
Update preferences persist on this installation, with guarded writes and one installation at a time.

entries.title: Reliable X chats and more workspace control
notes: X inbox previews resolve to full messages without duplicate bubbles. Delayed history appears in chronological order.
Genuine repeated messages stay intact, and search results still open the full original message.
Close the second chat pane directly without losing your other chat or its draft.
Create separate workspaces with their own account sign-ins, then rename or remove them from the workspace menu.
Discover related chats through shared members, with manual linking when you need it.
A larger update window puts release notes up front, with installation progress and clear close controls.

entries.title: Guided, recoverable account setup
notes: Telegram app-credential guidance, international phone validation, paced code retries and a separate two-step password screen
WhatsApp QR setup with linked-device guidance, safe code regeneration and resumable saved accounts
Downloadable X connector with exact-server pairing, expiry handling and encrypted X Chat passcode setup
Live connection confirmation instead of treating saved accounts as already connected
Isolated per-account browser sessions and automatic loading of new or replaced account credentials

entries.title: A redesigned messaging workspace
notes: Redesigned inbox, collapsible avatar rail, compact auto-growing composer, and improved direct and group messages
Improved chat history retention, delivery states, backfill controls, and connection health across messaging platforms
Automatic sticker and GIF recovery, inline media playback, PDF previews, and local image OCR search
People network map, in-chat search, shared files and links, and persistent drafts
Discord and Gmail connectors, local translation and dictation, and an optional mobile companion
Standalone contact profiles, customizable deal stages, tags, and an email follow-up queue

entries.title: Group chats, channels & a settings overhaul
notes: Create group chats from the app (⌘G) on Telegram & WhatsApp, with saved macros and reusable templates
Telegram channels — including read-only ones — with a channel badge, plus forum topics as tabs inside the chat
Group messages show per-member avatars and name tags; forward any message across platforms
Cal.com plugin: when a chat mentions a date it offers to book a meeting and auto-fills known emails
Full Settings: editable theme with light/dark accent colors, tags, folders, board stages, macros & templates
Update notice + one-click self-update, and start the sync worker straight from the app on localhost
Fix: group creation no longer hangs — sends now route to a live account, never a duplicate session

entries.title: Multi-account + browser-free sync
notes: Run multiple accounts per platform (Telegram, WhatsApp, X)
Browser-free drivers: WhatsApp via Baileys, X via the cookie API
"via @account" indicator shows which account a chat is on
Connections + onboarding redesigned for multiple accounts
